integrity: Complete derivation and independent-of-floating-point finite checks are supplied; finite tests supplement but do not establish the all-prime result.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes and the exponent-two residue ring are covered.
Equivalent results could occur under a different formulation in broader quadratic-Gauss-sum or association-scheme literature.
title: Integral Fourier spectrum of the traceless square-zero cone over prime-square rings
